title: The Wit that Won Hearts
subject: English
summary: “The Wit that Won Hearts” is an interesting story about the cleverness and intelligence of Tenali Rama, a famous poet in the court of King Krishnadeva Raya of Vijayanagara. One day, a proud scholar visited the king's court and challenged the court scholars to a debate. The scholars were afraid of losing and asked Tenali Rama for help. Tenali Rama accepted the challenge and cleverly used a bundle of sticks and a rope to confuse the scholar by calling them a difficult Sanskrit name, Tila-Kashta-Mahisha-Bandhana. The scholar could not understand its meaning and accepted defeat. Later, Tenali Rama explained the funny meaning of the words to the king. Everyone was impressed by his intelligence and quick thinking. The story teaches us that wit, wisdom and confidence can help us overcome difficult situations.
